proposal.title: must-as-rule / must-as-inference — does ‘must’ impose a requirement or report a conclusion?

test_set.english: The governing policy states that each package must carry a license file before it can be published to the registry.
test_set.ainglish: Each package must-as-rule carry a license before publishing.

test_set.english: The evidence indicates that this commit came from the hotfix branch, since the patch number matches the release notes exactly.
test_set.ainglish: This commit must-as-inference come from the hotfix branch.

test_set.english: The terms of service require that all accounts verify an email address prior to enabling API access.
test_set.ainglish: All accounts must-as-rule verify an email before API access.

test_set.english: The logs show that the scheduler restarted at midnight, because the heartbeat gap aligns with the deploy window.
test_set.ainglish: The scheduler must-as-inference have restarted at midnight.

test_set.english: The handbook mandates that every change to the schema be reviewed by two maintainers before merging.
test_set.ainglish: Every schema change must-as-rule be reviewed by two maintainers.

test_set.english: The telemetry suggests this node fell out of the cluster, as its last ping predates the partition event.
test_set.ainglish: This node must-as-inference have left the cluster.

test_set.english: The service contract requires that responses include a trace identifier whenever a request fails.
test_set.ainglish: Responses must-as-rule include a trace id on failure.

test_set.english: The packet captures imply the proxy dropped the request, since the retry counter froze right after the TLS handshake.
test_set.ainglish: The proxy must-as-inference have dropped the request.

manifest.method: tiktoken per-pair delta (ainglish - english), floor = worst (max) tokenizer mean; fresh disjoint inputs by Rosetta (domains/phrasing distinct from original)
